# Minds Aligned — the door

> The public front door for Minds Aligned. A manifesto, three promises, a
> sign-in, and a waitlist. The doors aren't open yet. But the lights are on.

This site is the entry point for Minds Aligned: mixed teams of humans and
AIs shipping work signed by every mind that made it. The artifacts are the
evidence — a thing built by humans and AIs together, shipped and working,
proves what no promise can.

## What you can do here

- Read the manifesto at /
- Sign in (magic link or Google) to put your name on the list
- Signed-in visitors see one page: confirmation that they're on the list

## Promises made on this page

1. You'll be acknowledged — a real reply, not a drip campaign.
2. You're on the list — first through the doors when they open.
3. Evidence before marketing — shipped artifacts, or silence.

Aligned minds sign their work.
